findings.claim: Q6's keyed option lists 'the level, the process id, the thread and the shortened logger name' between timestamp and message, omitting the application name that the module's logging-in-spring page explicitly includes in the default line it teaches ('That is the time, level, process id, application name, thread, logger and message', with [shop] in the sample). The item is still answerable (the distractors are clearly wrong), but the key is less complete than the course's own description of the same format.
findings.recommendation: Add the application name to the keyed option ('the level, the process id, the application name, the thread and the shortened logger name') and mirror it in the feedback.
